messages:
maria.security: Heads-up — we need an org-wide KMS key rotation for the primary prod-key (alias/redwood/prod). Compliance flagged an upcoming crypto policy change and our audit probes showed a small number of old-sig errors in logs. This is a coordinated change across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.

raj.sre: How likely is this to cause service interruptions? any dependent services we should stand down?

maria.security: Risk is low if you follow the runbook, but there are two gotchas: (1) some private deployments with cached wrapped keys may fail until their agents fetch the new public key, (2) CI runners using long-lived wrapped service keys will need ephemeral OIDC-bound creds.

infra-ops: Practical remediation steps are in the runbook: update the key, publish new public key, rotate service principals that use the key. Quick command for AWS KMS to create new key version: ```aws kms create-key --description "prod primary rotation" && aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/prod --target-key-id <new-key-id>``` Followed by updating the KMS key policy.

sec-bot: Automated scan results attached: 14 builds still referencing the legacy wrapped key, 3 partner connectors in Dedicated envs use the old key. See https://go/redwood/sec/kms-rotation-report for details.

dan.engineering: For private/on-prem customers, do we need to push a patch to the edge agent or will a key refresh suffice?

maria.security: Key refresh + agent certificate revalidation in some older releases (v1.8.x and older). Aleksa (platform) will post a short compat checklist.

aleksa.platform: Confirmed — agents >= v1.9 automatically refresh wrapped keys. For v1.8.x we have a one-line patch: `curl -fsS https://pkg.redwood.ai/agent/v1.8/refresh-key.sh | sudo bash` — run during your maintenance window.

raj.sre: I'll schedule a 30m maintenance window for the primary region tonight 01:30–02:00 UTC. Can engineers target non-peak services first?

sre-oncall: I'll own the page escalation if any services fail post-rotation. Please add me to the rotation ticket and set alerts for increased 5xx rates and KMS error codes.

maria.security: Thanks. Action items: (a) infra teams run the runbook and confirm in this thread when complete, (b) eng leads audit CI for wrapped key usage and migrate to OIDC-bound short-lived creds (guidance in runbook), (c) partner connectors owners ping partners to update. We expect full completion within 48 hours.

dan.engineering: Acknowledged — we'll migrate 6 pipelines tonight and post status.

raj.sre: Acknowledged :thumbsup:

infra-ops: Starting rotation now in staging, will report back when prod window starts.

maria.security: Appreciate it — tag me if you hit any permission policy blockers. If anyone needs emergency rollback instructions, see the rollback section in the runbook (link above).
